Build kit for "date range picker"

Start from the TEMPLATE, fill it with BLOCKS, and use COMPONENTS only for what is left.
Changing a page you already have? Keep it, and use only the blocks and components.

TEMPLATE
The idea is a part of a page and names no page, so it starts from the app shell. Scaffold it, then put blocks inside it.

name:        shell-top-nav
package:     @astryxdesign/core
displayName: Top Nav
description: Application frame with horizontal navigation only: a centered bar whose items open full-width mega-menu panels, over placeholder content that keeps the entire width.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template shell-top-nav --type page <path>

Install missing dependencies: npm install @heroicons/react@"^2.2.0"

This template uses StyleX. Your project needs a StyleX compiler plugin - see `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs styling-overview` for setup steps.

OTHER TEMPLATES
If the layout is wrong, scaffold one of these instead. All page templates: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template --list --type page

name:        course-detail
package:     @astryxdesign/core
displayName: Course Detail
description: Long-form sales page for a single offering, in two columns - read the pitch, then enroll from a sticky rail. The main column holds a preview poster with a fact row, an about block with skill chips, a module syllabus whose sections collapse module by module, an instructor card, reviews with a scored-aspects panel, and a FAQ; the rail holds the price, a self-paced or cohort start picker, and a weekly-pace slider that computes a finish date. The shape for any offering with a curriculum and a purchase panel - a course, class, masterclass, bootcamp, workshop, or training.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template course-detail --type page <path>

name:        useCalendarConstraints
package:     @astryxdesign/core
domain:      hook
score:       152
reason:      matches 3/3 terms: date, range, picker
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Calendar
description: Provides date constraint validation for calendar views and custom range pickers. It combines boundary dates, span limits measured from an in-progress range start, and custom rules (such as weekly closures or blackout dates) into an isDateDisabled predicate. Calendar uses it internally to disable day buttons; use it directly when building bespoke scheduling interfaces or range pickers.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useCalendarConstraints

name:        ComplexSelector
package:     @astryxdesign/core
domain:      component
score:       95
reason:      matches 1/3 terms: picker
import:      @astryxdesign/core/ComplexSelector
description: Use ComplexSelector when a selection needs richer custom content than a Selector option row. It is intentionally one component: ComplexSelector owns the field, trigger, popover, focus restore, and changeAction flow, while the content render prop owns the selector-specific accessible structure.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component ComplexSelector

name:        MultiSelector
package:     @astryxdesign/core
domain:      component
score:       95
reason:      matches 1/3 terms: picker
import:      @astryxdesign/core/MultiSelector
description: A checkbox dropdown for selecting multiple values from a list. Selected items can display as a count, labels, or badges. Use it for filtering or when presenting a finite set of options where multiple choices are needed.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component MultiSelector

name:        Selector
package:     @astryxdesign/core
domain:      component
score:       95
reason:      matches 1/3 terms: picker
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Selector
description: A dropdown selector for choosing a single value from a list of options. Supports labels, validation, descriptions, and required/optional states. Use it in forms and settings when presenting a moderate number of options. Keyboard typeahead matches a native select: typing on the focused closed trigger selects the matching option directly, repeated presses cycle through options sharing a first letter, and spaces count as match characters ("new y" reaches "New York"). With the menu open, typing moves the highlight and Enter commits. With hasSearch, typing on the closed trigger opens the popup and seeds the search input.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component Selector
